Package index

Overview

csvschema csvschema-package
csvschema: Self-Describing CSV Files with Embedded, Loss-Tolerant Schemas

Write and read

The one-call entry points: write a self-describing CSV, read it back with the schema recovered and applied, and inspect the report.

cs_write() cs_write_csv()
Write a self-describing CSV
cs_read_csv()
Read a self-describing CSV
cs_report()
Extract the csvschema report
cs_report_table()
Full csvschema report table

Schema model

Build a schema from a data frame and convert to and from Frictionless Table Schema v2 or plain reader specifications.

cs_schema() is_cs_schema()
Build a schema from a data frame
cs_schema_to_frictionless()
Convert an cs_schema to a Frictionless Table Schema list
cs_schema_from_frictionless()
Build an cs_schema from a Frictionless schema
cs_to_coltypes()
Emit base colClasses for utils::read.csv()
cs_to_readr_spec()
Emit a readr::cols() specification

Wire format (codec)

The packet encoding: percent-encoded tokens, CRC-32, packetization and fragmentation, parsing, and recovery with verification.

cs_encode_token()
Percent-encode a token
cs_decode_token()
Percent-decode a token
cs_crc32()
CRC-32 of a string as eight lowercase hex digits
cs_packetize()
Packetize a schema
cs_fragment()
Fragment a payload's attributes into packet-sized pieces
cs_parse_packets()
Parse packets out of character cells
cs_recover()
Recover a schema from parsed packets

Redundancy and layout

How many copies of each packet, and where they go across the rows.

cs_copies()
Minimum copies per packet
cs_redundancy()
Choose a redundancy layout
cs_survival()
Achieved failure probability for a layout
cs_stripe()
Rotating stripe assignment
cs_lay()
Materialize a stripe into schema columns

Canary

Sample fragile values per variable and detect, and name, data corruption.

cs_canary()
Build canary packets for every variable
cs_canary_sample()
Purposeful canary sample for one variable
cs_canary_check()
Verify data columns against their canaries

Lower-level I/O

Pieces used by the one-call writer and reader.

cs_write_sidecar()
Write a Frictionless sidecar for a schema
cs_apply_schema()
Apply a schema to a character data frame
cs_detect_columns()
Detect packet-bearing columns by content

Corruption simulators

One function per threat-model vector, for testing your own pipeline.

cs_corrupt_bom()
Prepend a UTF-8 BOM
cs_corrupt_case()
Change the case of every cell
cs_corrupt_columns()
Drop columns or split a column (Text-to-Columns)
cs_corrupt_delimiter()
Rewrite the delimiter with correct requoting
cs_corrupt_encoding()
Re-encode text (mojibake)
cs_corrupt_eol()
Swap line endings or drop the trailing newline
cs_corrupt_excel()
Simulate a spreadsheet's import coercions
cs_corrupt_header()
Remove or regenerate the header
cs_corrupt_invisible()
Insert zero-width spaces and soft hyphens
cs_corrupt_merge()
Bind two data frames with different schemas (version mixing)
cs_corrupt_replace()
Global find-and-replace across all cells
cs_corrupt_rows()
Drop, reorder, or duplicate rows
cs_corrupt_smartquotes()
Straight quotes to curly, -- to em dash
cs_corrupt_truncate()
Truncate every cell to n characters
cs_corrupt_whitespace()
Trim, pad, or non-breaking-space the text
